documents.from: Szilveszter Komlodi, ADM Fiscal Management and Capital Planning
documents.subject: Capital asset inventory - year-end count
documents.body: Departments must submit their year-end capital asset counts by March 26. Please use the revised template, which adds a column for asset location codes. Late submissions will delay the fixed asset reconciliation.
